_comment: The CI gate on the 100k set (step 14b): loadgen --nodes 100000 --clients 4 --seconds 3. Set from two runs on an Apple M4 Pro (documentation/benchmarks.md) with room for shared runners: throughput at least 1/5 of it, p99 latency at most 10x, the graph's own memory estimate at most ~40% above it. Not gated: commit.always (fsync cost depends on the runner's disk) and resident memory (allocator and OS noise).
